  <img class="lp-photo is-on" src="assets/img/landing/tangara-fastuosa.jpg" fetchpriority="high" width="1920" height="1440" style="object-position: 50% 28%" alt="Saíra-pintor pousada num talo verde, com folhas e fundo desfocado">
  <img class="lp-photo" data-src="assets/img/landing/acanthochelys-macrocephala.jpg" aria-hidden="true" width="1920" height="1280" style="object-position: 62% 55%" alt="Cágado-do-pantanal atravessando uma estrada de terra">
  <img class="lp-photo" data-src="assets/img/landing/leopardus-munoai.jpg" aria-hidden="true" width="1920" height="1215" style="object-position: 50% 65%" alt="Gato-palheiro-pampeano caminhando em direção à câmera, lambendo o focinho">
  <div class="lp-scrim" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="lp-hero-text">
    <h1 class="lp-rise">Saíra</h1>
    <p class="lp-sub lp-rise" style="--d: .15s">Darwin Core para a biodiversidade brasileira.</p>
    <div class="lp-actions lp-rise" style="--d: .3s">

    <button type="button" class="lp-biome" aria-pressed="false" data-sci="Boana buriti" data-fam="Hylidae" data-uf="Goiás" data-code="VU" data-cat="Vulnerável · MMA" data-credit="Reuber Brandão · CC BY 4.0"><span class="lp-prog"></span><span class="lp-biome-name">Cerrado</span><span class="lp-biome-sp">perereca-do-buriti</span></button>
    <button type="button" class="lp-biome" aria-pressed="true" data-sci="Tangara fastuosa" data-fam="Thraupidae" data-uf="Paraíba" data-code="VU" data-cat="Vulnerável · MMA" data-credit="Renato Bandeira · CC BY 4.0"><span class="lp-prog"></span><span class="lp-biome-name">Mata Atlântica</span><span class="lp-biome-sp">saíra-pintor</span></button>

<!-- ===================== DATA: the demo sheet fixed tab by tab, then the network map ===================== -->
<section class="lp-section lp-data" id="dados" aria-labelledby="dados-titulo">
  <div class="lp-head">
    <div>
      <span class="lp-eyebrow">Do Saíra ao SiBBr e ao GBIF</span>
      <h2 id="dados-titulo">Da planilha ao dado integrado.</h2>
      <p class="lp-lede">O Saíra converte a planilha para Darwin Core. O arquivo exportado pode ser publicado no SiBBr e no GBIF.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="lp-mod">
    <span class="lp-step"><b>01</b>No Saíra</span>
    <h3>Cada etapa traduz sua planilha para Darwin Core.</h3>
    <div class="lp-panel lp-flow" data-step="Etapa {n} de {total} · {tab}" data-raw="Planilha como chegou" data-done="Pronto. 6 linhas no occurrence.txt, 6 com coordenadas generalizadas.">
      <div class="lp-bar">
        <span class="lp-file">seis_biomas.csv<small>6 registros · uma espécie ameaçada por bioma</small></span>
        <button type="button" class="lp-toggle" data-pause="Pausar" data-play="Continuar">Pausar</button>
      </div>
      <ol class="lp-tabs" aria-label="Abas do Saíra">
        <li data-verb="lê o arquivo e a codificação"><b>1</b>Início</li>
        <li data-verb="associa colunas a termos"><b>2</b>Mapeamento</li>
        <li data-verb="mostra os registros mapeados"><b>3</b>Pré-visualização</li>
        <li data-verb="confere os nomes nas bases"><b>4</b>Nomes</li>
        <li data-verb="testa faixa, mar, país e inversão"><b>5</b>Coordenadas</li>
        <li data-verb="protege espécies ameaçadas"><b>6</b>Generalização</li>
        <li data-verb="gera datas ISO e IDs estáveis"><b>7</b>Exportação</li>
      </ol>
      <div class="lp-stage">
        <span class="lp-cap">Sua planilha</span>
        <div class="lp-scroll"><div class="lp-grid" role="table" aria-label="Planilha de demonstração" data-cols="Espécie|Lat|Long|Data|Estado"></div></div>
        <p class="lp-verb"></p>
      </div>
      <div class="lp-foot"><span class="lp-status">Planilha como chegou</span></div>
    </div>
    <p class="lp-note">Registros reais do GBIF, com erros inseridos para a demonstração. As seis espécies estão na lista do MMA, então as coordenadas saem numa grade de 0,1°.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="lp-mod lp-map">
    <div class="lp-map-text">
      <span class="lp-step"><b>02</b>Na rede</span>
      <h3>Ocorrências no SiBBr.</h3>
      <p class="lp-big"><strong>45.020.973</strong><span>ocorrências de espécies no SiBBr</span></p>
      <p>O SiBBr é o nó brasileiro do GBIF.</p>
      <p class="lp-src">Fontes: <a href="https://sibbr.gov.br/">SiBBr</a> e <a href="https://www.gbif.org/country/BR/summary">GBIF.org</a>, 9 out. 2026. Mapa base: <a href="https://openmaptiles.org/">© OpenMapTiles</a> <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">© colaboradores do OpenStreetMap</a>.</p>
    </div>
    <figure class="lp-mapfig">
      <img class="lp-map-img lp-map-light" src="assets/img/landing/brasil-light.jpg" width="1200" height="1209" loading="lazy" alt="Mapa do Brasil com a densidade de ocorrências publicadas no GBIF e as seis espécies da tabela">
      <img class="lp-map-img lp-map-dark" src="assets/img/landing/brasil-dark.jpg" width="1200" height="1209" loading="lazy" alt="Mapa do Brasil com a densidade de ocorrências publicadas no GBIF e as seis espécies da tabela">

      <span class="lp-card" style="--x: 24.72%; --y: 21.59%" aria-hidden="true"><img src="assets/img/landing/podocnemis-sextuberculata.jpg" loading="lazy" width="58" height="58" style="object-position: 70% 40%" alt=""><span><em>Podocnemis sextuberculata</em><span>iaçá</span><span class="lp-card-xy"></span><span class="lp-card-cat" data-code="EN">Em perigo · MMA</span></span></span>
      <span class="lp-card is-left" style="--x: 76.57%; --y: 48.49%" aria-hidden="true"><img src="assets/img/landing/micranthocereus-polyanthus.jpg" loading="lazy" width="58" height="58" style="object-position: 45% 50%" alt=""><span><em>Micranthocereus polyanthus</em><span class="lp-card-xy"></span><span class="lp-card-cat" data-code="EN">Em perigo · MMA</span></span></span>
      <span class="lp-card is-left" style="--x: 64.51%; --y: 54.4%" aria-hidden="true"><img src="assets/img/landing/boana-buriti.jpg" loading="lazy" width="58" height="58" style="object-position: 50% 54%" alt=""><span><em>Boana buriti</em><span>perereca-do-buriti</span><span class="lp-card-xy"></span><span class="lp-card-cat" data-code="VU">Vulnerável · MMA</span></span></span>
      <span class="lp-card is-left" style="--x: 92.56%; --y: 31.11%" aria-hidden="true"><img src="assets/img/landing/tangara-fastuosa.jpg" loading="lazy" width="58" height="58" style="object-position: 50% 28%" alt=""><span><em>Tangara fastuosa</em><span>saíra-pintor</span><span class="lp-card-xy"></span><span class="lp-card-cat" data-code="VU">Vulnerável · MMA</span></span></span>
      <span class="lp-card" style="--x: 43.5%; --y: 55.06%" aria-hidden="true"><img src="assets/img/landing/acanthochelys-macrocephala.jpg" loading="lazy" width="58" height="58" style="object-position: 62% 55%" alt=""><span><em>Acanthochelys macrocephala</em><span>cágado-do-pantanal</span><span class="lp-card-xy"></span><span class="lp-card-cat" data-code="VU">Vulnerável · MMA</span></span></span>
      <span class="lp-card" style="--x: 49.24%; --y: 88.34%" aria-hidden="true"><img src="assets/img/landing/leopardus-munoai.jpg" loading="lazy" width="58" height="58" style="object-position: 50% 65%" alt=""><span><em>Leopardus munoai</em><span>gato-palheiro-pampeano</span><span class="lp-card-xy"></span><span class="lp-card-cat" data-code="CR">Criticamente em perigo · MMA</span></span></span>

<!-- ===================== INSTALL: tabs for the app (Windows, Linux) and the R package; the R tab keeps the console replay ===================== -->
<section class="lp-section lp-install" id="instalar" aria-labelledby="instalar-titulo">
  <div class="lp-install-text">
    <span class="lp-eyebrow">Instalação</span>
    <h2 id="instalar-titulo">Baixe o app ou instale pelo R</h2>
    <p>Escolha o app para o seu sistema. Ele já traz o R. Se você já usa R, instale o pacote pelo console, no Windows ou no Linux.</p>
    <p class="lp-small">Dúvidas? Veja o <a href="tutoriais/01-instalacao.html">tutorial de instalação</a>. Achou um erro? <a href="https://github.com/rogerio-onza/saira/issues">Abra uma issue</a>.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="lp-get">
    <div class="lp-get-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Forma de instalação">
      <div class="lp-get-group"><span class="lp-get-label" aria-hidden="true">App</span><div>
        <button type="button" role="tab" id="lp-tab-win" data-os="windows" aria-controls="lp-pane-win" aria-selected="true">Windows</button>
        <button type="button" role="tab" id="lp-tab-linux" data-os="linux" aria-controls="lp-pane-linux" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Linux</button>
      </div></div>
      <span class="lp-get-sep" aria-hidden="true"></span>
      <div class="lp-get-group"><span class="lp-get-label" aria-hidden="true">R</span><div>
        <button type="button" role="tab" id="lp-tab-r" data-os="r" aria-controls="lp-pane-r" aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Pacote R</button>
      </div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="lp-app" role="tabpanel" id="lp-pane-win" aria-labelledby="lp-tab-win">
      <div class="lp-app-head"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="3" width="20" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8"/><path d="M12 17v4"/></svg><div><h3>Saíra para Windows</h3><span class="lp-app-meta">64 bits</span></div></div>
      <ul><li>Já traz o R e todas as dependências.</li><li>Abre numa janela própria, sem navegador.</li></ul>
      <a class="lp-btn lp-dl" href="https://github.com/rogerio-onza/saira/releases/latest"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v12"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M5 21h14"/></svg>Baixar para Windows</a>
    </div>
    <div class="lp-app" role="tabpanel" id="lp-pane-linux" aria-labelledby="lp-tab-linux" hidden>
      <div class="lp-app-head"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="2" y="3" width="20" height="14" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8"/><path d="M12 17v4"/></svg><div><h3>Saíra para Linux</h3><span class="lp-app-meta">64 bits</span></div></div>
      <ul><li>Já traz o R e todas as dependências.</li><li>Abre numa janela própria, sem navegador.</li></ul>
      <a class="lp-btn lp-dl" href="https://github.com/rogerio-onza/saira/releases/latest"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v12"/><path d="m7 10 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M5 21h14"/></svg>Baixar para Linux</a>
    </div>
    <div class="lp-get-r" role="tabpanel" id="lp-pane-r" aria-labelledby="lp-tab-r" hidden>
      <p>No Windows ou no Linux, com o R 4.1 ou superior. Depois, <code>saira::run_app()</code> abre o app no navegador.</p>
      <figure class="lp-term" aria-labelledby="lp-term-label">
        <div class="lp-term-bar">
          <div class="lp-tl" aria-hidden="true"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
          <figcaption id="lp-term-label" class="lp-term-label">Console · R</figcaption>
          <button type="button" class="lp-copy" data-copied="Copiado" data-copy='options(repos = c(&#10;  ropensci = "https://ropensci.r-universe.dev",&#10;  CRAN     = "https://cloud.r-project.org"&#10;))&#10;install.packages("pak")&#10;pak::pak("rogerio-onza/saira")&#10;saira::run_app()'>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V5a2 2 0 012-2h10"/></svg>
            <span>Copiar</span>
          </button>
        </div>
        <pre class="visually-hidden">options(repos = c(ropensci = "https://ropensci.r-universe.dev", CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))&#10;install.packages("pak")&#10;pak::pak("rogerio-onza/saira")&#10;saira::run_app()</pre>
        <div class="lp-term-body" aria-hidden="true">
          <div class="lp-term-line"><span class="pr">&gt; </span><span class="fn">options</span>(repos = <span class="fn">c</span>(</div>
          <div class="lp-term-line"><span class="pr">+ </span>  ropensci = <span class="str">"https://ropensci.r-universe.dev"</span>,</div>
          <div class="lp-term-line"><span class="pr">+ </span>  CRAN     = <span class="str">"https://cloud.r-project.org"</span></div>
          <div class="lp-term-line"><span class="pr">+ </span>))</div>
          <div class="lp-term-line"><span class="pr">&gt; </span><span class="fn">install.packages</span>(<span class="str">"pak"</span>)</div>
          <div class="lp-term-line"><span class="pr">&gt; </span><span class="fn">pak::pak</span>(<span class="str">"rogerio-onza/saira"</span>)</div>
          <div class="lp-term-line"><span class="pr">&gt; </span><span class="fn">saira::run_app</span>()</div>
          <div class="lp-term-line" data-out data-wait="350"><span class="out">package ‘pak’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked</span></div>
          <div class="lp-term-line" data-out data-wait="250"><span class="out">→ Will install 128 packages.</span></div>
          <div class="lp-term-line" data-out data-wait="1100"><span class="pr">ℹ </span><span class="out">Getting 128 pkgs</span><span class="lp-term-prog"><i></i></span></div>
          <div class="lp-term-line" data-out data-wait="350"><span class="str">✔ </span><span class="out">Installed saira <span data-saira-version>0.11.2</span> (github::rogerio-onza/saira)</span></div>
          <div class="lp-term-line" data-out><span class="out">Listening on </span><span>http://127.0.0.1:7346</span></div>
        </div>
      </figure>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

</div>
